include_once comm_PerDefinition.txt

// -------------------------------------------------------
// 4.3 指挥车（陆军无人集群指挥车）
// 部署：作战用户网
// 通信：C波段（上下行分档）+ L波段（上下行分档）
// -------------------------------------------------------
platform_type COMMAND_VEHICLE_PLATFORM WSF_PLATFORM
  radar_signature COMMAND_VEHICLE_SIG

  mover WSF_SURFACE_MOVER
    update_interval 1 sec
  end_mover

  // C波段上行（SNR→速率分档）
  comm c_band_uplink WSF_RADIO_TRANSCEIVER
    on
    network_name COM_MESH_NET
    add medium UAV_MESH_MEDIUM
      channels 4
      mode "default"
        transfer_rate constant 2000000 bit/s //-------------界面配置
        //bit_error_probability 0.00001
      end_mode
    end_medium
    //channels 4
    transmitter
      frequency 4.5 GHz   //-------------界面配置
      bandwidth 10 MHz //-------------界面配置
      power 20 W //-------------界面配置
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern C_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_VEHICLE_ANTENNA
      //antenna_tilt -3 deg
      
      attenuation_model none
      end_attenuation_model
    end_transmitter

    receiver
      frequency 4.5 GHz //-------------界面配置
      bandwidth 10 MHz //-------------界面配置
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern C_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_VEHICLE_ANTENNA
      //antenna_tilt -3 deg
      noise_figure 3 dB //-------------界面配置
    end_receiver
    internal_link script_proc
  end_comm

  // C波段下行（SNR→速率分档）
  comm c_band_downlink WSF_RADIO_TRANSCEIVER
     on
    network_name COM_MESH_NET
    add medium UAV_MESH_MEDIUM
      channels 4
      mode "default"
        transfer_rate constant 8000000 bit/s //-------------界面配置
        //bit_error_probability 0.00001
      end_mode
    end_medium
    //channels 4

    transmitter
      frequency 4.0 GHz //-------------界面配置
      bandwidth 20 MHz //-------------界面配置
      power 30 W //-------------界面配置
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern C_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_VEHICLE_ANTENNA
      //antenna_tilt -3 deg
      attenuation_model none
      end_attenuation_model
    end_transmitter

    receiver
      frequency 4.0 GHz //-------------界面配置
      bandwidth 20 MHz //-------------界面配置
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern C_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_VEHICLE_ANTENNA
      //antenna_tilt -3 deg
      noise_figure 3 dB //-------------界面配置
    end_receiver
    
    internal_link script_proc
  end_comm

  // L波段上行（SNR→速率分档）
  comm l_band_uplink WSF_RADIO_TRANSCEIVER
    on
    network_name COM_MESH_NET
    add medium UAV_MESH_MEDIUM
      channels 4
      mode "default"
        transfer_rate constant 12800 bit/s //-------------界面配置
        //bit_error_probability 0.00001
      end_mode
    end_medium
    //channels 4
    transmitter
      frequency 1.5 GHz //-------------界面配置
      bandwidth 5 MHz //-------------界面配置
      power 10 W //-------------界面配置
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern L_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_VEHICLE_ANTENNA
      attenuation_model none
      end_attenuation_model
    end_transmitter

    receiver
      frequency 1.5 GHz //-------------界面配置
      bandwidth 5 MHz //-------------界面配置
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern L_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_VEHICLE_ANTENNA
      noise_figure 3 dB //-------------界面配置
    end_receiver

    internal_link script_proc
  end_comm

  // L波段下行（SNR→速率分档）
  comm l_band_downlink WSF_RADIO_TRANSCEIVER
     on
    network_name COM_MESH_NET
    add medium UAV_MESH_MEDIUM
        channels 4
        mode "default"
            transfer_rate constant 2000000 bit/s //-------------界面配置
            //bit_error_probability 0.00001
        end_mode
    end_medium
    //channels 4
    transmitter
      frequency 1.3 GHz //-------------界面配置
      bandwidth 10 MHz //-------------界面配置
      power 15 W //-------------界面配置
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern L_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_VEHICLE_ANTENNA
      attenuation_model none
      end_attenuation_model
    end_transmitter

    receiver
      frequency 1.3 GHz //-------------界面配置
      bandwidth 10 MHz //-------------界面配置
      polarization vertical
      antenna_pattern L_BAND_DIRECTIONAL_VEHICLE_ANTENNA
      noise_figure 3 dB //-------------界面配置
    end_receiver

    internal_link script_proc
  end_comm

  comm fiber_link WSF_COMM_TRANSCEIVER
    on
    network_name FIBER_NET
    transfer_rate 1000 mbits/sec        // 光缆传输能力
    channels 4
    internal_link script_proc
  end_comm

  
  processor script_proc WSF_SCRIPT_PROCESSOR
    report_to commander via fiber_link

    script_variables
    end_script_variables

    on_message
    end_on_message
    
  end_processor
end_platform_type
